text:
Anil: Quick check — vendor asked if we still need the APAC H100 slots for the overnight canary window (Tue->Wed). We said yes but I want to confirm exact SKUs/serials and invoice lead time before I ok the terraform change. Anyone oncall for procurement?

Maya: I'm around. Which pool are we talking about — dedicated-prod-dedicated1 or demo-canary?

Anil: demo-canary. We want 4 H100s for 6 hours nightly for the canary tests, then release to standby.

vendor-bot: vendor update: APAC partner reports tentative allocation for 6 H100s next week; ETA for serials and invoice PDF: 36-48h. Link: https://partner.example.com/alloc/ABC123 (auth required).

Chris: FYI we can hot-swap a1 slots from standby if the vendor slips. Not ideal for latency but ok for validation runs.

Lucy: tagging @Priya — procurement - can you confirm invoice timing / PO lead so Anil can merge the TF PR? :eyes:

Priya: saw this — I pinged vendor via email. If they confirm allocation by EOD we can do standard 3-business-day PO processing, invoice should arrive 24-48h after allocation. If they require net-30 it'll delay.

Suneel: For the terraform change, use this var so terraform plan shows the reserve: ```
variable "canary_h100_count" {
  type = number
  default = 4
}
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "canary" {
  region = "apac-east1"
  sku = "h100"
  count = var.canary_h100_count
  lease_window = "6h"
}
```

Anil: thanks. Vendor asked for target start date — can we request Wed 03:00 local? That aligns with our quiet window.

Maya: Wed 03:00 APAC local works for ops. I'll block the window in calendar and update the canary runbooks.

Priya: vendor responded: allocation OK for Wed 03:00 local, serials tbd but will be posted to partner portal within 24h. I'll flag net-30 risk.

Chris: I'll open a quick fallback playbook to borrow 4 standby H100s if serials don't appear by Tue EOD. Minimal changes: small flag in runner to point to standby pool.

Anil: perfect — I'll land the TF change guarded behind a feature flag and add a note in the PR: "apply only after vendor alloc confirmed and invoice uploaded". PR link dropped here once ready. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: automated note: ticket #VEND-942 updated by Priya.

Lucy: great coordination — thanks everyone.

Anil: PR is up: https://git.internal/infra/PR/4821 — added var + apply guard, left TODO for procurement attach invoice.

Suneel: lgtm, small nit in doc string but can follow up after merge.

Priya: will post invoice pdf to the vendor ticket as soon as received.

Anil: dropping a final checklist here: 1) vendor confirms allocation (Priya) 2) invoice in ticket (Priya) 3) ops calendar block + runbook updated (Maya) 4) TF guarded PR merged (Anil) 5) fallback ready (Chris). I'll mark done as we close.

Maya: noted. I'll also add a short smoke test to the canary to validate perf under H100.

Chris: added a quick terraform snippet to the fallback runbook, ping me in thread if you want me to commit it.

Anil: thanks all, closing the loop here — will update thread when PR merged or vendor slips.
